categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly updates the invalidateblock RPC error reporting.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where invalidateblock reports success even when disconnecting or invalidating a block fails (Issue #36546). Ensuring RPC methods do not falsely signal success when state changes fail is critical to RPC return correctness and prevents misleading node operators and test harnesses.
